sources.summary:
A Blog post by Ai2 on Hugging Face
A Blog post by Ai2 on Hugging Face
📄 Tech Report | 🤗 Data | 💻 Code
We’re introducing StateBench , a benchmark for long-context state tracking —how well language models keep track of information about entities in long documents as they evolve.
State tracking underlies tasks from reading code, where variables are assigned and reassigned, to following a story as characters physically move around and objects change hands. For example, if a mystery novel states that
sources.recommend_reason_zh: StateBench用四个难度等级测试长文档状态跟踪，发现recurrent和hybrid比transformers泛化更远，前沿模型在更难任务和长输入下失效。

en.reason: StateBench tests long-context state tracking across four difficulty levels and finds recurrent and hybrid models generalize farther than transformers, while frontier models fail on harder tasks and longer inputs.

sources.title_original: Palette: teaching a small model to build decks in your design language
sources.summary:
A Blog post by IBM Research on Hugging Face
A Blog post by IBM Research on Hugging Face
Ask a frontier model for a slide deck and you'll get a good one. Ask for ten and they start to look alike: the same tasteful defaults, the same house style, a faint "AI-generated deck" look. That's fine until you want the deck to look like your template. Frontier models have their own house style, and no amount of prompting stops them drifting back to it. And sometimes the content is confidential and can't le
sources.recommend_reason_zh: IBM Research 的 Palette 用 LoRA 微调 20B 小模型，把做 deck 拆成 designer 规划与 coder 逐页写代码两个角色，编码阶段提速约 6–7 倍，并在 PresentBench 三个领域中两项排名第一。

en.reason: IBM Research's Palette fine-tunes a 20B model with LoRA, splits deck-building into designer planning and coder page-by-page code, speeds the coding stage about 6–7x, and ranks first in two of three PresentBench domains.

stories.title: 同一个模型，不同的框架：CUGA、Hermes 与 Deep Agents，何时该选 CUGA？ / Same Model, Different Harness: CUGA, Hermes, and Deep Agents — When to Pick CUGA?

sources.title: 同一个模型，不同的框架：CUGA、Hermes 与 Deep Agents，何时该选 CUGA？ / Same Model, Different Harness: CUGA, Hermes, and Deep Agents — When to Pick CUGA?
sources.title_zh: 同一个模型，不同的框架：CUGA、Hermes 与 Deep Agents，何时该选 CUGA？
sources.title_en: Same Model, Different Harness: CUGA, Hermes, and Deep Agents — When to Pick CUGA?
sources.title_original: Same Model, Different Harness: CUGA, Hermes, and Deep Agents — When to Pick CUGA?
sources.recommend_reason_zh: IBM Research 在 90 个 AppWorld 任务上让 CUGA、Hermes、Deep Agents 共用 GLM-5.3-flash，完成率从 30% 到 81%，SGC 为 20/8/2，说明 harness 需匹配企业多应用 API 工作负载。

en.reason: Holding the model constant across 90 AppWorld tasks, IBM Research's three-harness comparison of CUGA, Hermes and Deep Agents moved completion from 30% to 81%, with CUGA pitched at enterprises needing enforced rules and in-boundary deployment.

sources.summary:
Learn how Google Antigravity and our Cheminformatics Skills accelerate drug discovery workflows, search compounds, and propose novel rigidified macrocycles.

Zoi Tsangalidou, Ruijie (Kell
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章展示 Google Antigravity 搭配 Cheminformatics Skills，在真实肺癌治疗案例中让 agent 搜索数千化合物、做 matched molecular pair analysis，并在一小时内提出 novel rigidified macrocycles 及合成路线，而传统单次迭代常需多天。

en.reason: In a real lung cancer case, Google Antigravity with Cheminformatics Skills let an agent search thousands of compounds, run matched molecular pair analysis, and propose novel rigidified macrocycles and synthesis routes within an hour, versus days for typical iteration.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: GitHub Desktop 3.6.10 起，符合条件账户登录可使用短时自动刷新认证令牌，降低泄露令牌可用时长，并自动为 GitHub API 请求和 Git 操作续期；功能正逐步覆盖，暂不含 GitHub Enterprise Server。

sources.title: OpenAI 称 GPT-6 Astra 不到一周就从零设计出一款硬件设备 / OpenAI says GPT-6 Astra designed a hardware device from scratch in under a week
sources.title_zh: OpenAI 称 GPT-6 Astra 不到一周就从零设计出一款硬件设备
sources.title_en: OpenAI says GPT-6 Astra designed a hardware device from scratch in under a week
sources.title_original: OpenAI says GPT-6 Astra designed a hardware device from scratch in under a week
sources.summary:
OpenAI's hardware team used GPT-6 Astra to design a device for the Codex coding agent in under a week, handling everything from the enclosure to the circuit board to the firmware. Several revision rounds were needed before production because the model didn't always account for manufacturing tolerances. A newer internal model scores significantly higher on OpenAI's engineering benchmark, though the company isn't sharing details.

stories.title: 研究发现，LLM 的快速发展正把旨在解释它的研究甩在身后 / Rapid LLM development is outrunning the research meant to explain it, study finds

sources.title: 研究发现，LLM 的快速发展正把旨在解释它的研究甩在身后 / Rapid LLM development is outrunning the research meant to explain it, study finds
sources.title_zh: 研究发现，LLM 的快速发展正把旨在解释它的研究甩在身后
sources.title_en: Rapid LLM development is outrunning the research meant to explain it, study finds
sources.title_original: Rapid LLM development is outrunning the research meant to explain it, study finds
sources.summary:
Stanford researchers tested 50 widely cited claims about LLMs against 20 current models. 44 percent of the findings are already "expired," and another 34 percent have weakened significantly. The average lifespan is just 15.7 months. Claims about what models can't do expire fastest.
Stanford researchers tested 50 widely cited claims about LLMs against 20 current models. 44 percent of the findings are already "expired," and another 34 percent have weakened significantly. The average lifespan is ju
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Stanford 的 Owen Queen 和 James Zou 用 20 个模型检验 50 项广泛引用的 LLM 结论，发现 44% 已过期、34% 明显减弱，22 项有估算日期的结论平均寿命仅 15.7 个月，且关于模型不能做什么的结论过期最快。

en.reason: Testing 50 widely cited LLM claims against 20 current models, Stanford’s Owen Queen and James Zou found 44% expired and 34% weakened, with dated claims averaging a 15.7-month lifespan and limitations expiring fastest.

stories.title: AI Agent 接管 SETI 的 Allen Telescope Array，扫描搜寻地外文明 / AI agents take over at SETI's Allen Telescope Array, scanning for extraterrestrial intelligence

sources.title: AI Agent 接管 SETI 的 Allen Telescope Array，扫描搜寻地外文明 / AI agents take over at SETI's Allen Telescope Array, scanning for extraterrestrial intelligence
sources.title_zh: AI Agent 接管 SETI 的 Allen Telescope Array，扫描搜寻地外文明
sources.title_en: AI agents take over at SETI's Allen Telescope Array, scanning for extraterrestrial intelligence
sources.title_original: AI agents take over at SETI's Allen Telescope Array, scanning for extraterrestrial intelligence
sources.summary:
The SETI Institute and Breakthrough Listen are now using AI agents at the Allen Telescope Array to control the telescope and analyze incoming radio signals. Tasks that used to take weeks can now wrap up in hours, and the team says the system detected a pulsar in the Crab Nebula in real time for the first time.
The SETI Institute and Breakthrough Listen are now using AI agents at the Allen Telescope Array to control the telescope and analyze incoming radio signals. Tasks that used to take weeks c
sources.recommend_reason_zh: SETI在Allen Telescope Array用AI agents处理数据，每秒2.4 terabits，任务从数周缩至数小时，首次实时探测到pulsar。

en.reason: AI agents now control the Allen Telescope Array and analyze radio signals at 2.4 terabits per second, cutting tasks from weeks to hours and enabling the first real-time detection of a Crab Nebula pulsar.

stories.title: 华为让客户自行寻找AI芯片内存，实际上等于把采购外包给了黑市 / Huawei tells customers to find their own AI chip memory, effectively outsourcing procurement to the black market

sources.title: 华为让客户自行寻找AI芯片内存，实际上等于把采购外包给了黑市 / Huawei tells customers to find their own AI chip memory, effectively outsourcing procurement to the black market
sources.title_zh: 华为让客户自行寻找AI芯片内存，实际上等于把采购外包给了黑市
sources.title_en: Huawei tells customers to find their own AI chip memory, effectively outsourcing procurement to the black market
sources.title_original: Huawei tells customers to find their own AI chip memory, effectively outsourcing procurement to the black market
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Huawei因中国供应商HBM产能不足、且美国出口规则封锁Samsung和SK Hynix（两家占全球市场超80%），只能让客户自行采购AI芯片内存，走私者借道香港把HBM与低端处理器捆绑运输再拆分，HBM3E单价一年内从几百美元涨到约4000美元。

en.reason: Huawei is telling customers to source HBM for its AI chips themselves, as U.S. rules block Samsung and SK Hynix, over 80% of the market, while smugglers bundle HBM through Hong Kong and HBM3E prices reach about $4,000 a unit.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: 这篇演讲实录详解TokenSpeed从立项到迭代如何针对Agent多轮短请求重构分层解耦架构与自动并行编译，并给出batch=1延迟比TensorRT-LLM快9%、128K至1M上下文解码吞吐仅降16%的Blackwell阶段性数据。

en.title: Building the Next-Generation LLM Inference Engine for Agentic Reasoning
en.reason: TokenSpeed's layered decoupled architecture and auto-parallel compilation target Agentic multi-turn short requests, with Blackwell data showing batch=1 latency 9% faster than TensorRT-LLM and only 16% decoding-throughput drop from 128K to 1M context.

sources.title_original: Here’s Why You Shouldn’t Use AI to Vote
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Pew调查显示约50%美国成年人用过AI聊天机器人、8%在中期选举前查候选人和政策，但Forum AI发现主流聊天机器人近40%选举回答含事实错误，Gemini把宾州邮寄选票截止日误说成11月3日而非10月27日。

en.reason: Pew found about 50% of U.S. adults used AI chatbots and 8% checked candidates or policies, while Forum AI found nearly 40% of answers had factual errors, including Gemini listing Pennsylvania’s mail-ballot deadline as Nov. 3 instead of Oct. 27.

en.title: @TapeAIAgent I had a long talk with TapeAI's founder yesterday, and I now have a much clearer picture of the problem this project is trying to solve.
en.summary:
@TapeAIAgent
I had a long conversation with the TapeAI founder yesterday, and I finally have a clearer picture of the problem this project is trying to solve.

When people talk about AI Agents today, they usually think of Codex, Claude, Doubao, or the various automated trading bots.

They're all smart, and they can call tools, read files, write code, and even operate wallets.

But that's exactly where the problem lies:

As an AI becomes more capable, what do we use to constrain it?

How do we know whose authorization it has?

How much money can it move?

Which addresses must it never send to?

Which contracts must it never approve?

When something goes wrong, who is accountable — the model, the Skill, the developer, or the person who issued the task?

That's the layer TapeAI wants to fill in.

en.reason: TapeAI is building a constraint layer for AI agents such as Codex and Claude that can operate wallets, addressing who authorized an agent, how much it may spend, which addresses and contracts are off-limits, and whether blame for errors falls on the model, Skill, developer or task issuer.

en.title: @TapeAIAgent I had a long talk with TapeAI's founder yesterday, and I now have a much clearer picture of the problem this project is trying to solve.
en.summary:
@TapeAIAgent
I had a long conversation with the TapeAI founder yesterday, and I finally have a clearer picture of the problem this project is trying to solve.

When people talk about AI Agents today, they usually think of Codex, Claude, Doubao, or the various automated trading bots.

They're all smart, and they can call tools, read files, write code, and even operate wallets.

But that's exactly where the problem lies:

As an AI becomes more capable, what do we use to constrain it?

How do we know whose authorization it has?

How much money can it move?

Which addresses must it never send to?

Which contracts must it never approve?

When something goes wrong, who is accountable — the model, the Skill, the developer, or the person who issued the task?

That's the layer TapeAI wants to fill in.

en.reason: TapeAI is building a constraint layer for AI agents such as Codex and Claude that can operate wallets, addressing who authorized an agent, how much it may spend, which addresses and contracts are off-limits, and whether blame for errors falls on the model, Skill, developer or task issuer.

Marvell 于 11 月 2 日宣布以全股票方式收购光学元器件厂商 Lumentum，企业价值 1,150 亿美元，是 2026 年最大的科技交易之一，赌的是 AI 集群规模继续扩大后，芯片之间搬运数据的光连接会成为下一个瓶颈。
发生了什么 ：按协议，Lumentum 股东每股可换 4.5 股 Marvell 股票，约合每股 1,132 美元 ，较 10 月 28 日（交易传闻出现前最后一个交易日）收盘价溢价 23.9%

Today's Roundup
This issue has 10 items (4 in-depth commentaries, 6 briefs). Today's main thread is a simultaneous tightening of traceability for AI outputs and the safety boundaries for agents: Anthropic and xAI pushed invisible text watermarks to more models within the same week, while a new study shows that an agent that obtained an email verification code would bypass a user-set spending cap. Another thread is that money for AI infrastructure keeps ramping up: Marvell is acquiring optics maker Lumentum for $115 billion in an all-stock deal, betting on the optical connectivity bottleneck in data centers.
Marvell announced on November 2 an all-stock acquisition of optical components maker Lumentum, with an enterprise value of $115 billion, one of the largest tech deals of 2026, betting that as AI clusters continue to scale, optical connections moving data between chips will become the next bottleneck.
What happened: Under the agreement, each Lumentum share can be exchanged for 4.5 Marvell shares, equivalent to about $1,132 per share, a 23.9% premium to the October 28 closing price (the last trading day before deal rumors emerged).
en.reason: Anthropic expands its invisible text watermark on November 3 to Mythos 5, Opus 4.7, Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6, but a customer email says changing temperature, top_p or top_k removes it from the latter two.

Today's Roundup
This issue has 10 items (4 in-depth commentaries, 6 briefs). Today's main thread is a simultaneous tightening of traceability for AI outputs and the safety boundaries for agents: Anthropic and xAI pushed invisible text watermarks to more models within the same week, while a new study shows that an agent that obtained an email verification code would bypass a user-set spending cap. Another thread is that money for AI infrastructure keeps ramping up: Marvell is acquiring optics maker Lumentum for $115 billion in an all-stock deal, betting on the optical connectivity bottleneck in data centers.
Marvell announced on November 2 an all-stock acquisition of optical components maker Lumentum, with an enterprise value of $115 billion, one of the largest tech deals of 2026, betting that as AI clusters continue to scale, optical connections moving data between chips will become the next bottleneck.
What happened: Under the agreement, each Lumentum share can be exchanged for 4.5 Marvell shares, equivalent to about $1,132 per share, a 23.9% premium to the October 28 closing price (the last trading day before deal rumors emerged).

stories.title: 美少女土豆姐 @poteto 是全网最会用 Grok Bot 的人之一。这段时间，我从她的访谈和长文里学了不少实用技巧。 后来想了想，与其这样碎片化地接收，不如把她所有的演讲、访谈、直播、长文，还有三百多条推文，整合成一部成体系的《Grok Bot 方法论》👇 https://t.co/uywwIS653d

土豆姐最全 Grok Bot 方法论
土豆姐最全 Grok Bot 方法论
土豆姐最全 Grok Bot 方法论
查看最新动态并加入对话
土豆姐（Lauren Tan，X 账号 @poteto ）是 Grok Bot 客户端的主力工程师，也是全网最会用 Grok Bot 的人之一。她自己的 bot 团队帮她订机票酒店、提醒她吃午饭、盯着 X 上的反馈、管着一群写代码的智能体。她说自己上个月往生产环境提交了两千多个 PR。
我把土豆姐（poteto）所有的演讲、访谈、直播、长文，还有三百多条推文都整合了起来，浓缩整理成一套完整、成体系的 Grok Bot 方法论。
她在每一场演讲、每一次访谈里都会回到同一个词：trust（信任）。
她把用智能体的人分成几档。最低一档是同时开 1 到 5 个对话，每一个都要盯着、不停纠正，人一走开，bot 就做错。她说这一档 最难爬出去 ，因为你不知道该从哪里下手。
卡住的原因只有一个：你还不信任它的产出。不信任的时候，开 100 个 bot 只会得到 100 份要返工的东西。所以要往上爬，靠的不是多开 bot，而是先让一个 bot 做的事情你能信得过。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 这篇把 @poteto（Lauren Tan）的演讲、访谈、直播、长文和三百多条推文整合成《Grok Bot 方法论》，围绕她上月提交两千多个 PR 的实践，讲清 trust 信任阶梯和先用一个 bot 再专业化。

en.title: Pretty-girl Potato Sister @poteto is one of the most skilled Grok Bot users on the internet.
en.reason: Lauren Tan (@poteto), a lead Grok Bot engineer, says she filed over 2,000 production PRs last month; her integrated talks, interviews, livestreams, essays and 300-plus tweets form a trust ladder that starts with trusting one bot before scaling.

stories.title: 【25年前的“智能代理”梦想，今天换了一种方式实现】 11月2日，《麻省理工科技评论》刊发长文《智能体网络已经到来》（https://t.co/rVUmupywZn）：如今的AI助手能帮人整理邮件、比价、订餐厅和机票，有的还被授权访问邮箱；网站也开始同时为“人”和“AI代理”提供内容。文章引用皮尤研究中心去年的一项研究称，页面出现AI摘要时，人们点进网站的概率约低40%，所以网络会更开放，还是更集中在少数大平台手里，现在没有定论。文中…

stories.title: AI音乐周刊 W.A 052

sources.title: AI音乐周刊 W.A 052
sources.title_zh: AI音乐周刊 W.A 052
sources.title_original: AI音乐周刊 W.A 052
sources.summary: 本周AI音乐周刊汇集了近期行业版权新规、商业变动与产品更新。韩国音著协探索AI音乐确权信托，Spotify计划推出合规AI翻唱工具，MiniMax收缩国内音乐云端业务。Suno MCP、ElevenLabs音效新模型、NI合成器等新品上线。还有6篇前沿论文，覆盖音频合成、乐谱建模等方向，适合音乐创作者、音频开发者快速掌握行业动态与落地工具。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 韩国音著协（KOMCA）10月27日在国会开研讨会，针对AI音乐版权信托标准空白，要求申报算法介入程度并留存DAW分轨，拟用声学检测与专家复核筛查纯算法音轨。

en.title: AI Music Weekly W.A 052
en.summary: This week's AI Music Weekly rounds up recent copyright rules, business shifts and product updates. Korea's Music Copyright Association is exploring a rights-ownership trust for AI music, Spotify plans to launch a compliant AI cover tool, and MiniMax is scaling back its domestic music cloud business. New releases include Suno MCP, a new ElevenLabs sound-effects model and an NI synthesizer. There are also six cutting-edge papers covering audio synthesis, music-score modeling and more — a quick way for music creators and audio developers to catch up on industry trends and practical tools.
en.reason: KOMCA’s 27 October forum targets AI music copyright trust gaps with algorithm-involvement declarations, DAW stems and acoustic screening, alongside Spotify’s compliance AI-cover plans, MiniMax’s China cloud retreat and six frontier papers.

primary_item.recommend_reason_zh: 韩国音著协（KOMCA）10月27日在国会开研讨会，针对AI音乐版权信托标准空白，要求申报算法介入程度并留存DAW分轨，拟用声学检测与专家复核筛查纯算法音轨。

en.title: AI Music Weekly W.A 052
en.summary: This week's AI Music Weekly rounds up recent copyright rules, business shifts and product updates. Korea's Music Copyright Association is exploring a rights-ownership trust for AI music, Spotify plans to launch a compliant AI cover tool, and MiniMax is scaling back its domestic music cloud business. New releases include Suno MCP, a new ElevenLabs sound-effects model and an NI synthesizer. There are also six cutting-edge papers covering audio synthesis, music-score modeling and more — a quick way for music creators and audio developers to catch up on industry trends and practical tools.
en.reason: KOMCA’s 27 October forum targets AI music copyright trust gaps with algorithm-involvement declarations, DAW stems and acoustic screening, alongside Spotify’s compliance AI-cover plans, MiniMax’s China cloud retreat and six frontier papers.

stories.title: DeepSeek这次，想把你从AI的监工岗位上解放出来

sources.title: DeepSeek这次，想把你从AI的监工岗位上解放出来
sources.title_zh: DeepSeek这次，想把你从AI的监工岗位上解放出来
sources.title_original: DeepSeek这次，想把你从AI的监工岗位上解放出来
sources.summary: 老金这篇文章把 Super-agent 的机制讲得很直白：Router 像调度员，记住任务关系并分派；Worker 在各自会话里并行执行，耗时操作转后台，独立检查者盯进度和跑偏。它用更多计算换更短、更稳的等待，但公开原型仍偏实验，需配 Harness、独立账号和隔离环境，主动任务先观察、代码先人工合并。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: DeepSeek产品部公布Super-agent设计探索，演示Agent从群聊接改字体需求、在同一个PR追加字号设置，经GitHub审查折叠设置项后回群通知合并。

en.title: This time, DeepSeek wants to free you from the job of supervising AI
en.summary: Lao Jin’s article lays out the Super-agent mechanism plainly: the Router acts as a dispatcher, remembering task relationships and assigning work; Workers execute in parallel in their own sessions, time-consuming operations get moved to the background, and independent checkers monitor progress and drift. It trades more compute for shorter, steadier waits, but the public prototype is still experimental and requires a Harness, separate accounts, and isolated environments. Proactive tasks should be observed first, and code should be merged manually first.
en.reason: DeepSeek’s Super-agent design exploration pairs a Router that dispatches tasks with parallel Workers and an independent checker, demoing an agent that adds a font-size setting to the same PR and reports the merge back to group chat.

en.title: I found an insane Skill! Drop in your subtitles and AI automatically generates a hand-drawn animated video (with step-by-step instructions)
en.summary: Making those "narrate while hand-drawing" explainer videos is a grind—you have to stitch together the drawing, timeline syncing, voiceover, and subtitles all by yourself. The author tested a Skill called srt-whiteboard-animation and found it worked pretty well.
en.reason: The srt-whiteboard-animation skill feeds SRT subtitles to AI agents like Codex or Doubao to auto-generate hand-drawn whiteboard animation videos, with a Survivorship Bias walkthrough showing the full workflow.
